When [[Dejah Duare]], [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], and [[I-5YQ]] went to make a trade with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in exchange for [[Laranth Tarak]] and [[Kajin Savaros]] they were met by three hooded [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]]: Jax Pavan who was disguised as an Inquisitor, [[Probus Tesla]], and another '''Inquisitor'''. They escorted them to Vader, to took and used the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] extract. In his ensuing, uncontrollable Force blast, the Inquisitor was caught by one of these blasts and was crushed.<ref name="CN3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Inquisitor first appeared in [[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force|''Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force'']]. It is possible the Inquisitor speaks as when Dejah, Rhinann and I-Five are taken by him an Inquisitor says "You will accompany us," and "Cease talking," but it isn't made clear as to whether it is this Inquisitor, Probus Tesla or Jax Pavan that says it.<ref name="CN3" />
